title: GIS Monitoring of Vineyard Ripening (Brix) at Quinta de Nossa Senhora de Lurdes, Vila Real, Portugal
description: GIS and NDVI-based monitoring of grape ripening (degrees Brix) at a 6-hectare vineyard: logarithmic regression harvest-date forecasting (R2 = 0.9784), spatial interpolation of sugar accumulation across five sampling dates, and land-use mapping.
